column1: # Labelled messages held out from rule tuning. Do not change rules to fix misses in this file; add similar cases to the dev split instead.
# Columns: id, label (scam|legit), language (en|hi|mr|hinglish|mixed), text. "\n" in text means a line break.
# Written for CyberShield in the style of scams described in public advisories and of ordinary SMS/WhatsApp traffic.
# They are not copies of real messages; phone numbers and links are fictitious.
